content: वितॄ €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To cross or pass over, go beyond; आरूढमद्रीनुदधीन् वितीर्णम् <ls>R. 6. 77</ls>. .²2 To give, grant, impart, confer or bestow on, vouchsafe, favour with; भगवान् मारीचस्ते दर्शनं वितरति <ls>Ś. 7</ls>; वितरति गुरुः प्राज्ञे विद्यां यथैव तथा जडे <ls>U. 2. 4</ls>; वितरति नृपो नोचितमहो <ls>Pt. 1. 11</ls>; <ls>U. 3. 48</ls>; निवासहेतोरुटजं वितेरुः <ls>R. 14. 81</ls>; <ls>Māl. 1. 3</ls>, <ls n="Māl.">6. 7</ls>, <ls n="Māl.">9. 5</ls>, <ls n="Māl. 9.">44</ls>. .²3 To cause, produce; ज्योत्स्नाशङ्कामिह वितरति हंसश्रेणी <ls>Ki. 5. 31</ls>. .²4 To carry over, ferry over. .²5 To give (as medicine), apply a remedy. .²6 To do, perform. .²7 To forgive, pardon. .²8 To increase, enhance. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To carry through, accomplish (<ab>fig.</ab> also).
